apis.name: OpenWeatherMap
apis.why_notable: Widely used weather forecasts, historical data, and air quality with a generous free tier.

apis.name: WeatherAPI.com
apis.why_notable: Simple REST weather API covering forecasts, history, astronomy, and sports.

apis.name: Open-Meteo
apis.why_notable: Free open-source weather API with no API key required for non-commercial use.

apis.name: National Weather Service (api.weather.gov)
apis.why_notable: Official US government weather API — free, no key, authoritative forecasts and alerts.

apis.name: Visual Crossing Weather
apis.why_notable: Timeline weather API with rich historical data and forecasts in one call.

apis.name: Tomorrow.io
apis.why_notable: Hyperlocal weather, climate, and air quality with timeline and map layers APIs.

apis.name: Weatherbit
apis.why_notable: Global weather, air quality, and energy/agri APIs with clear free developer tier.

apis.name: AccuWeather
apis.why_notable: Enterprise-grade forecasts, severe weather, and indices; free limited developer keys.

apis.name: Meteostat
apis.why_notable: Historical weather and climate data from stations and models, free for developers.

apis.name: IQAir AirVisual
apis.why_notable: Global air quality (AQI) and pollution data from monitoring stations and satellites.

apis.name: OpenAQ
apis.why_notable: Open-source global air quality measurements aggregated from government sources.

apis.name: AirNow (EPA)
apis.why_notable: US EPA official air quality index, forecasts, and observation API.

apis.name: NASA POWER
apis.why_notable: NASA solar and meteorological data for energy, agriculture, and climate research.

apis.name: NOAA Climate Data Online / NCEI
apis.why_notable: Authoritative US climate and weather station archives via CDO web services.

apis.name: USGS Water Services
apis.why_notable: Real-time and historical streamflow, groundwater, and water quality data.

apis.name: OpenUV
apis.why_notable: Real-time and forecast UV index API for health and outdoor apps.

apis.name: Stormglass
apis.why_notable: Marine and weather API combining multiple models for ocean and coastal use.

apis.name: World Air Quality Index (WAQI / aqicn)
apis.why_notable: Global real-time AQI from thousands of stations; popular free token tier.

apis.name: Meteoblue
apis.why_notable: High-resolution weather and climate APIs used for science and industry.

apis.name: Bright Sky
apis.why_notable: Free open German weather API wrapping DWD data with a clean JSON interface.

apis.name: Pirate Weather
apis.why_notable: Dark Sky–compatible free weather API replacement after Apple shutdown.

apis.name: World Weather Online
apis.why_notable: Multi-product weather, marine, ski, and historical APIs with free trial tier.
